Post object fields and updated_at collision on writes back to Ghost. This specimen does not write posts.

Custom integration keys and outgoing webhooks.

HMAC over raw JSON plus decimal milliseconds, and a 2 second request timeout. Source sets retry.limit to 5 outside test mode. Installed Ghost 6.73.0 uses got 16, whose default methods omit POST, so a failed POST was not retried. Duplicate delivery in that run used a second subscription.
Payload shape post.current and post.previous. HTML and plaintext formats for posts.
